description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans gateway connection handling, including reconnection logic, cluster mismatch scenarios, and gateway management within a test environment.

classes.name: TestGatewayManager
classes.description: Implements IGatewayListProvider to provide a list of gateway URIs for testing purposes, with configurable staleness and updatability.

classes.name: GatewayConnectionTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for verifying gateway connection behaviors, including reconnection logic and rejection of connections from different clusters.

classes.name: SiloBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures silo options for local testing, including ports.

classes.name: ClientBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures client options, including gateway list refresh period and custom gateway manager.

methods.name: InitializeGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Initializes the gateway list provider, here simply returning a completed task.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Returns the current list of gateway URIs.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the host builder for silo setup.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the client builder with gateway options and services.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes the test, retrieving the runtime client from the service provider.

methods.name: NoReconnectionToGatewayNotReturnedByManager
methods.description: Test verifying that the client only connects once to a fake gateway and handles disconnection properly.

methods.name: ConnectionFromDifferentClusterIsRejected
methods.description: Test verifying that connection attempts from a different cluster are rejected with an appropriate exception.
